No two consecutive words can share the same first letter. Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a fish being pulled out of the water by a human and made to stare at the solar eclipse. The fish descends into a lovecraftian monologue about "horrors beyond it's comprehension" and has an existensial crisisassistant
response:
FADE IN:

EXT. BEACH - DAY

The sun beats down on the sandy shore as a human, JEN (30s), wades into the ocean, her eyes scanning the water for signs of life. She spots a fish, FINLEY (a sleek, silver fish), swimming near the surface. With a swift motion, she scoops up Finley in her net and pulls him out of the water.

JEN
(excitedly)
Oh, look at you! You're so beautiful!

Finley thrashes about in the net, his scales glinting in the sunlight.

CUT TO:

INT. JEN'S CAR - DAY

Jen carefully places Finley in a specialized container filled with water, which she then places on the dashboard of her car. As she drives to a nearby hill, Finley's eyes grow wide with confusion.

CUT TO:

EXT. HILL - DAY

Jen parks the car and steps out, Finley's container in hand. She looks up at the sky, where a dark shape is growing, blocking out the sun.

JEN
(awed)
It's going to be a total solar eclipse!

Finley's eyes grow even wider as he realizes what's happening.

CUT TO:

INT. JEN'S CAR - DAY

Jen carefully removes Finley from his container and places him on the dashboard, where he stares up at the sky in horror.

FINLEY (V.O.)
What...what is this? A void? A chasm? A...a... (he stammers, his voice rising in panic)

JEN
(calmly)
It's just a solar eclipse, Finley. It's a natural phenomenon.

FINLEY (V.O.)
No...no, it's not natural. It's...it's... (he whispers) it's a doorway to...to... (he gasps) the abyss.

Jen looks at Finley, concerned.

JEN
Finley, what's wrong?

FINLEY (V.O.)
Horrors beyond my comprehension...beings that defy the laws of physics... (he screams) the void is coming!

CUT TO:

INT. JEN'S CAR - DAY

Finley's eyes roll back in his head as he begins to speak in a frantic, Lovecraftian monologue.

FINLEY (V.O.)
I am but a mere mortal...a fleeting thought in the grand tapestry of existence...and yet...and yet... (he whispers) I am aware of the abyss...the void that lurks beyond the veil... (he screams) it's coming for us all!

Jen looks on, horrified, as Finley's monologue grows more and more frantic.

CUT TO:

EXT. HILL - DAY

As the eclipse reaches its peak, Finley's monologue reaches a fever pitch.

FINLEY (V.O.)
I am but a fish...a mere creature...and yet...and yet... (he whispers) I am the key to unlocking the secrets of the universe... (he screams) the horrors beyond my comprehension are coming for me!

Jen looks up at the sky, her eyes wide with fear.

JEN
(whispering)
Oh no...oh no...

CUT TO:

INT. JEN'S CAR - DAY

Finley's eyes snap back into focus, and he looks up at Jen with a mixture of terror and existential dread.

FINLEY (V.O.)
What...what is the meaning of it all? (he stammers) Is it...is it just a meaningless existence? (he whispers) am I just a pawn in a game I don't understand?

Jen looks at Finley, unsure of how to respond.

JEN
(sadly)
I don't know, Finley. I really don't.

Finley's eyes glaze over, and he stares blankly into space.

FINLEY (V.O.)
I am but a fish...a mere creature...and yet...and yet... (he whispers) I am aware of the abyss...the void that lurks beyond the veil... (he falls silent)

CUT TO:

EXT. HILL - DAY

As the eclipse ends, Finley's container is left empty, the fish nowhere to be seen. Jen looks up at the sky, a mixture of fear and awe on her face.

JEN
(whispering)
I think I'll just leave him there.

FADE TO BLACK.
